comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Effect: Increase treasure gained -- 1-hour duration

This is the same effect that the Statue of Ariadne has; when a player is under the effect of that item, they gain an additional Mysterious Gold (Labyrinth) or Orichalcum (Temple of Poseidon) from the boss floor treasure chest.

I am confident this bonfire has a similar purpose, and hopefully it can be tested soon.
